source.quote: If a house stands for a certain subject matter, the lord of the house will also be considered to be concerned with it.
source.quote_display: If a house stands for a certain subject matter, the lord of the house will also be considered to be concerned with it.

predicts.rule: the lord of a house carries that house's subject matter

cards.note: Editorial preamble rather than a numbered verse, but it states the principle that makes karaka doctrine usable at all: a house's subject is read from its lord as well as from the house.

source.quote: The Sun is the singnificator of the person's collection of copper and gold, and of father, patience, valour, victory in war, one's soul (Atman), auspiciousness, happiness, prowess, power, light, any work relating to Lord Shiva, travels in forests and mountains, havans or yajnas, Inclinations for work, temple, acuteness, enthusiasm. Wise men should act according to these significations.

Wise men should act according to these significations.

source.quote: The Moon is the signiflcator of the welfare of the mother, tranquilityof the mind, bathing in the sea, white chamar, umbrella, good fan, fruits, flowers, tender objects, farming grains, fame, pearls, silver, bell metal, beauty. In other words all about the above matters should be ascertained from the Moon.

source.quote: From Mercury is to be ascertained all about learning, eloquence, proficiency in arts, praise by learned people, maternal uncle, dexterity in speech, aptness for acquiring knowledge, expertise in ways of worship, intelligence, religious acts relating to Lord Shiva, truthfulness, oyster, spots of recreation and enjoyment, skill in mechanical arts, kinsmen, heir apparent, friends, sister's sons and daughters etc.

source.quote: Jupiter is concerned with matters relating to knowledge, noble qualities, sons (progeny), minister, good behavior, imparting knowledge or teaching, magnanimity, knowledge of shruties, shastras, smrities, progress in every direction, beautitude, devotion towards gods and Brahmins, sacrifice, penance, religious faith, treasury, mastering the senses, honour, kindness and happiness of the husband.

source.quote: All about one's wealth, conveyances, clothes, ornaments, treasures (including hidden treasures), amalgam of song, dance and instrumental music, scents, flowers, co-habitation, bed, house, richness, fondness for poetry, Indulgence in all kinds of comforts and luxuries, ministership, soft-spokenness, marriage and other holy deeds, celebrations, etc., should be ascertained through Venus.

source.quote: The significations of Saturn are longevity, death, fear, downfall, disgrace, sickness, unhappiness and misery, poverty, humiliation, sins, labour, filth, censure, misfortune, impurity of mind, observance of certain formalities after death in the family, stability, taking shelter from menials, buffaloe, drowsiness, debts, articles of iron, service, slavery, confinement, getting arrested, agricultural implements etc.

source.quote: In a male's horoscope Jupiter, among other matters, is the significator for progeny (San tan Karaka).

source.quote: Note — In a male's horoscope all about the happiness of wife and marital happiness should be considered through Venus. Venus is the significator for wife in such a chart.

source.quote: A planet in the Ascendant of a nativity bestows his qualities and characteristics to the native.
source.quote_display: A planet in the Ascendant of a nativity bestows his qualities and characteristics to the native.

cards.note: Quantified over the grahas: one claim per graha in the lagna.

source.quote: If there is no planet in the Ascendant the native assumes the appearance and characteristics of the lord of the Ascendant.
source.quote_display: If there is no planet in the Ascendant the native assumes the appearance and characteristics of the lord of the Ascendant.

cards.note: The emptiness test is a negated existential over the occupants of the lagna; the lord comes from the lordship table. Both are now expressible, so the card states exactly what the verse states.

source.quote: The planets who aspect the Ascendant also inject the Influence of their characteristics and temperament in the native.
source.quote_display: The planets who aspect the Ascendant also inject the Influence of their characteristics and temperament in the native.

cards.note: Full drishti onto the lagna, one claim per aspecting graha.

source.quote: If a planet in any chart becomes the cause of any disease, the nature of the disease will be according to the temperament of that planet. For example, the Sun will cause bilious troubles and Saturn will give windy troubles.
source.quote_display: If a planet in any chart becomes the cause of any disease, the nature of the disease will be according to the temperament of that planet. For example, the Sun will cause bilious troubles and Saturn will give windy troubles.

cards.note: States how to read a disease off whichever graha caused it, but not which graha causes one. Needs the rule that identifies the cause before it can be applied.

source.quote: The temperament of the Sun is bilious. He has strong bones in his body. He has scanty hair. He has a dark red form. His eyes are of reddish-brown color. He is dressed in red colored clothes. His body is square built. He is brave and possesses massive arms.
source.quote_display: The temperament of the Sun is bilious. He has strong bones in his body. He has scanty hair. He has a dark red form. His eyes are of reddish-brown color. He is dressed in red colored clothes. His body is square built. He is brave and possesses massive arms.

source.quote:
The body of the Moon is huge. She is young as well as old. She is lean and thin and white. Her eyes are attractive and her hair is black and thin. She has jurisdiction over blood. She is soft-spoken. She is dressed in white colored clothes and possesses fair complexion. She is mild in temperament and has wind and […] <!-- page phaladeepika/p0020 -->
phlegm in her composition.

source.quote: Mars has lean waist. His hair is curly and bright. There is cruelty (fierceness) in his look. He has a cruel nature and is bilious. He is dressed in red clothes and his body has a red hue. He is wrathful but exceedingly generous. He looks youthful and has jurisdiction over marrow in the body.
source.quote_display: Mars has lean waist. His hair is curly and bright. There is cruelty (fierceness) in his look. He has a cruel nature and is bilious. He is dressed in red clothes and his body has a red hue. He is wrathful but exceedingly generous. He looks youthful and has jurisdiction over marrow in the body.

source.quote: Mercury is green like Durva (a kind of grass). There is mixture of wind, bile and phlegm in his composition. His body is full of veins. He is soft-spoken by nature. He has a balanced built (that is, his limbs are in even proportion). He is fond of fun and frolic. He governs the skin.
source.quote_display: Mercury is green like Durva (a kind of grass). There is mixture of wind, bile and phlegm in his composition. His body is full of veins. He is soft-spoken by nature. He has a balanced built (that is, his limbs are in even proportion). He is fond of fun and frolic. He governs the skin.

source.quote: Jupiter has a body with a yellowish hue. His eyes and hair are brown. His chest is firm and elevated. He has a huge body. Phlegm is predominant in his composition. He is very intelligent. His voice is like that of a lion or the sound of a conch. He is always after wealth (Jupiter has therefore been considered as signiflcator of wealth).

He is very intelligent. His voice is like that of a lion or the sound of a conch. He is always after wealth (Jupiter has therefore been considered as signiflcator of wealth).

source.quote: Venus is dressed in clothes of various colors. He possesses curly hair. He has a huge body with similar limbs. Phlegm and wind are predominant in his composition. His body is of the color of Durva sprout. He has a very beautiful appearance. He has broad eyes. He has well maintained his virile power (Venus has jurisdiction over semen in the body).

His body is of the color of Durva sprout. He has a very beautiful appearance. He has broad eyes. He has well maintained his virile power (Venus has jurisdiction over semen in the body).

source.quote: Saturn is lame. His eyes are deepset. He has a large but lean body full of veins. He is lazy by nature. The color of his body is black. There is predominance of wind in his composition. He is hard hearted and backbiter. He is dull-headed. His teeth and nails are large. His hair and limbs are stiff. He is impure. He has a fierce appearance and is ill tempered by nature. He is dressed in black clothes. He looks old.

source.quote: Notes — Mars is said to be youthful in appearance. The implication of this is if Mars is strong in the Ascendant or as lord of the Ascendant, the native will have a youthful appearance even if he is older in age.

cards.note: The Mars-in-lagna leaf is exact, but the rule is conditioned on a *strong* Mars and on lagna lordship, neither of which the engine can establish.

source.quote: The places governed by the Sun are a Shiva temple, open spaces, places where there is light, regions where there is no water and the Eastern quarter.
source.quote_display: The places governed by the Sun are a Shiva temple, open spaces, places where there is light, regions where there is no water and the Eastern quarter.

source.quote: The Moon has jurisdiction over the temple of Goddess Durga, places inhabited by women, places where water, medicinal herbs, honey and wine are available and the North-Western quarter.
source.quote_display: The Moon has jurisdiction over the temple of Goddess Durga, places inhabited by women, places where water, medicinal herbs, honey and wine are available and the North-Western quarter.

source.quote: The places concerned with Mars are the battle field, those where there is fire, those inhabited by thieves and low people and the Southern quarter.
source.quote_display: The places concerned with Mars are the battle field, those where there is fire, those inhabited by thieves and low people and the Southern quarter.

source.quote: The governance of Mercury extends to places where there is a temple of Lord Vishnu, those frequented by men of learning, those of recreation, those where Mathematics is practiced and the Northern quarter.

source.quote_display: The places coming under the administration of Venus are abodes of courtesans, the harem, bed rooms, dining halls, and the South-Eastern quarter.

source.quote: Saturn rules over places inhabited by low class people, temple of Shasta (a deity), those which are full of filth and the Western quarter.

source.quote: The places belonging to Rahu and Ketu are the ant-hills, the dark holes of serpents and the South-Western quarter.

source.quote: A worshipper of Lord Shiva, a physician (Vaidya), a king, one who performs yajna, a minister, tiger, deer and chako (the ruddy goose) are the significations of the Sun.

source.quote: Mercury is concerned with a milkman, a person of learning, an artisan, an expert accountant, a devotee of Lord Vishnu, Garuda, a Chataka, a parrot and a cat.

cards.note: A four-column table the scan interleaved past reconstruction. The row for the Sun reads 'Sun Moon, Mercury Venus Mars Saturn Jupiter': all six other grahas are present but the column boundaries are gone, and one row shows a literal '-----'. Assigning each graha to friend, neutral or enemy would mean importing the classical table from outside this quote, which is exactly what the rule store exists to prevent. The quote is encoded; the assignment waits for a human with the printed page.

source.quote: Planets are mutually friendly for the time being when they occupy the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 10th, 11th and 12th houses from one another. (This means that planets occupying the 1st, 5th, 6th 7th, 8th, and 9th from one another are mutually inimical).

cards.note: The parenthesis giving the inimical houses is the translator's inference from the verse, printed inside it.

source.quote: After taking into account the natural friendship and enmity, it should be deduced whether they are friendly, very friendly, neutral, inimical and very inimical to one another.
source.quote_display: After taking into account the natural friendship and enmity, it should be deduced whether they are friendly, very friendly, neutral, inimical and very inimical to one another.

source.quote: Note — Apart from the neutral or natural friendship and enmity amongst the planets, account is taken of the for the time being (Tatkalik) enmity and friendship […] amongst the planets as posited in a particular birth chart. The planets posited in the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 10th, 11th and 12th from a particular planet are his friends for the time being. The 1st, 5th, 6th, 7th, 8th and 9th from him become his enemies for the time being. After taking into account the natural relationship, we come to know what their actual relationship is in a particular birth chart.

source.quote: This is done in the following manner : 1. Natural friend + Temporary friend = Best friend (Naisargik mitra) (Tatkalik Mitra) (Adhimitra) 2. Natural friend + Temporary enemy = Neutral (Naisargik Mitra) (Tatkalik Shatru (Sama) 3. Natural enemy + Temporary enemy = Bitter enemy (Naisargik (Tatakalik Shatru) (Adhishatru) Shatru) 4. Natural enemy + Temporary friend = Neutral (Naisargik (Tatkalik Mitra) (Sama) Shatru) 5. Natural neutral + (Temporary Friend = Friend (Mitra) (Naisargik Sama) (Tatkalik Mitra) 6. Natural neutral + Temporary enemy = Enemy (Naisargik Sama) (Tatkalik Shatru) (Shatru)

source.quote: The Sun is signiflcator of father if the birth is during the day time and uncle if the birth is during night time. He has special influence on the right eye.
source.quote_display: The Sun is signiflcator of father if the birth is during the day time and uncle if the birth is during night time. He has special influence on the right eye.

cards.note: Verse 1 makes the Sun the significator of the father without qualification; this verse makes it so only for a day birth, and gives the father to Saturn at night. Both are encoded and neither is corrected. The Sun and Saturn entries are complementary, not contradictory: they partition day from night.

source.quote: The Sun represents the soul and the Moon the body. Mars and the other four planets denote the five senses. The Sun and Mars govern Teja and have influence over eye sight. The Moon and Venus rule over the generative organs because they govern the watery element. Mercury governs smell (nose). Jupiter governs sound (the capacity to hear). Saturn, Rahu and Ketu govern the touch.

conditional.as_printed: Mercury if associated with them becomes malefic.

cards.note: The source dep.nature reads. Note that it is not a fixed list: the Moon's nature turns on its phase and Mercury's on its company, so the extractor needs the Moon's phase and conjunctions, not a table. `measured_from: Sun` is an addition by the encoder, not words from the verse: the text says only "waning", and a waning Moon is one moving away from full toward new, which is defined by its elongation from the Sun. It is recorded here rather than in Engine/facts.py so that it is citable and overridable, and so no graha name appears in the reasoning layer.

source.quote: Notes — The waxing Moon and Mercury not associated with malefics will be treated as benefic.
source.quote_display: Notes — The waxing Moon and Mercury not associated with malefics will be treated as benefic.

cards.note: `grahas` is empty, and that is the finding rather than an omission. Between them verse 27 and this note classify the Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu, the Moon (by phase) and Mercury (by company), and say nothing whatever about Jupiter or Venus. The tradition treats both as benefic and Phaladeepika does state it -- but in chapter 4, under Kala Bala ("The Moon, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus are benefics"), which is not encoded. Inferring their nature by exclusion from the malefic list would be the engine supplying doctrine, so it is not done: `nature` emits no fact for Jupiter or Venus, and any card conditioned on a benefic under-fires until chapter 4 is encoded. Recorded as concept:phaladeepika.nature-benefics.

source.quote: The planets should be considered adversely disposed, if they are eclipsed (by the rays of the Sun), debilitated (be in a sign of debilitation or Navamsa), if they are in any enemy's house or if they occupy the 6th, 8th or the 12th house from the Ascendant. If they occupy other places, they are said to be well disposed.

cards.note: Three of the six alternatives are house placements the engine can already test, but the rule is quantified over the grahas and the debilitation clause covers Navamsa as well as Rasi.

source.quote: If there be a query whether the water in a reservoir (or in an irrigation project) will increase or decrease, increase in water should be predicted if the Moon be in the 12th 11th, 1st, 6th. 5th or the 7th house at the time of the query.
source.quote_display: If there be a query whether the water in a reservoir (or in an irrigation project) will increase or decrease, increase in water should be predicted if the Moon be in the 12th 11th, 1st, 6th. 5th or the 7th house at the time of the query.

cards.note: A horary rule: it reads the chart of the moment a question is asked, not a nativity. Its condition is exactly expressible and would fire on a birth chart, which is precisely why it must not.

Notes — The Moon is said to be eclipsed if she is 12° away from the Sun. […] <!-- page phaladeepika/p0027 -->

Jupiter, Venus and Saturn are said to be eclipsed if they are 11°, 10° and 15° respectively away from the Sun. A retrograde Venus is eclipsed if he is 8° away from the Sun.
